$comment: C77 §1.1 — the DECLARED columns of the Secrets & Configuration Register.
PRESENCE, NEVER VALUE (C77 §2.4). This file contains NAMES and judgements about
names — classification, requiredness, sharing, failure mode. It must NEVER
contain a value, a fingerprint of a value, or a prod set/unset claim (§0.2:
prod status is NOT-ESTABLISHED-FROM-CODE; a static file may not guess).
These columns are DECLARED, not generated, because they cannot be derived from
code that may be wrong (the COORD-01 lesson). The measured columns (read-sites,
service, surface) are generated by check-secrets-register.ts and joined against
this file into docs/04-reference/SECRETS-REGISTER.md.
SEEDED 2026-08-12 from the EXECUTED inventory in
docs/04-reference/BIM30-SECRETS-MAPPING-AUDIT.md §2 (HEAD f4a2d999). Rows are
added ONLY with the four columns argued — a name the scan finds that has no row
here is the gate's arm-a finding, and declaring everything the scan finds would
make arm a a tautology. Do NOT bulk-declare to make the gate green.
classification: SECRET (never public) / PUBLIC-TOKEN (client-safe by design —
MUST be domain/API-restricted at the provider) / CONFIG (non-secret).
required: required / optional / required-in-prod-only.
sharedWith: services that must hold the BYTE-IDENTICAL value (C77 §2.2).
failureMode: hard-exit / ephemeral-fallback / degraded-feature / broken-bundle,
with detail. C77 §1.3: ephemeral-fallback is a declared mode, not a silent one.

declarations.name: SESSION_SECRET
declarations.note: BFF signs the session JWT (server/authStore.js:33); sync-server verifies the WS upgrade with the SAME bytes (apps/sync-server/src/auth/WsAuthGate.ts). The dev fallback mints randomBytes(48) per process and only warns — C77 §1.3 requires its consumer to escalate louder. The realised §5 incident lives on this row.
